narrative.overview: Colsdown uses a cream ground, aubergine lettering and purple, lavender, lime and orange regions to make editable columns tangible. The approved release artwork keeps the established brand while making its composition demonstrate the product.
rules: The rounded nesting card meets the lime preset rail without a vertical gutter.
The version sits on cream, separated from the purple nesting card.
Soft shadows belong to the version and mechanism cards.
dos: Do preserve the modular concept, editable source and native-source provenance together.
Do show the four mechanisms in the established palette.
donts: Don't replace visual mechanisms with blank caption panels.
Don't give one benefit a different font size or weight from the other three.
